implementation: createResolver with allowConfigExecution; no policies injected by the audit and no per-project overrides
supplementalScope: Nine explicit Node builtin checks and twelve original-source Node lookups for Rollup-externalized requests. These do not alter the primary comparison or establish automatic layer assignment/build equivalence.
requestContext: browser/development for Vite and Next client comparisons; node/production for Node and Rollup; import or require selected per request
identityComparison: Raw identities retained; file URLs normalized to filesystem paths with query/fragment for comparison. Matching unresolved outcomes are not passes.
